debut.label: The Escape
debut.heading: 2001: Breaking the Wall
debut.description: The foundational era of The Paper Wall. A raw, industrial, and autobiographical rock project driven by frontman Julian Croft.

albums.title: Static & Silence
albums.description: A sprawling two-part rock opera detailing an agonizing descent into an industrial nightmare and a raw, unfiltered journey back home to the safety of family.

albums.title: The Eleventh Child: A Gauntlet of Hearts
albums.description: A cinematic, narrative-driven exploration of trauma and survival. This rock opera serves as the grand finale where industrial cages are shattered by an unbreakable gauntlet of hearts, ending in pure stadium-rock euphoria.
